free_text: The patient is a 70-year-old male with a high PSA of 11.2 ng/mL and a prior biopsy grade of 4+4 (ISUP Grade Group 4). The mpMRI showed a PI-RADS 5 lesion with restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was noted. Given the high-risk pathological findings and elevated PSA, the management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
